dossier.headline: BSE wins US approval to offer Bankex futures
dossier.summary: BSE has received US regulatory approval to offer its Bankex index futures to American investors, Business Standard reported on Tuesday. The stock is among the day's stocks to watch.
why_it_matters: It opens a new pool of overseas investors to a BSE derivative product
